facts.text: I have been into collecting vinyl records for a few months.
I am looking for recommendations on how to properly clean and maintain vinyl records.
I am thinking about investing in a record cleaning machine.
I want to compare the pros and cons of popular record cleaning machines like the Record Doctor and Spin Clean.
I am thinking about displaying some of my favorite vinyl records on the wall.
I want suggestions for displaying records safely without damaging the records or the wall.
I have a mint condition copy of The Beatles' "Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band" that I want to display on the wall.
I have a limited edition pressing of Fleetwood Mac's "Rumours" that I want to display.
I have a rare 7-inch single of David Bowie's "Space Oddity" that I want to display.
I want suggestions for creating a visually appealing record display that showcases multiple records at once.
I want to display my rare 7-inch single of David Bowie's "Space Oddity" alongside my limited edition pressing of Fleetwood Mac's "Rumours".
I want a display that highlights the unique features of each record.

keyphrases: mint condition "Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band"
